defects.description: No dedicated individual ministry drilldown screen exists; all ministries render as compact cards inside one page.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to #ministries in sidebar. 2. Observe list of ministry cards. 3. Click card. Notice no separate deep-dive view opens.
defects.expected_result: Clicking a ministry card should open a comprehensive portfolio view showing subordinate directorates, historical G.O.s, and gazetted milestones.
defects.actual_result: Card renders inline without expandable deep-dive view.
defects.root_cause: Ministry route currently uses compact inline grid in App.tsx without separate MinistryDetail modal/page component.
defects.business_impact: CM cannot drill down into specific subordinate boards (e.g. TWAD Board under Municipal Administration) directly from Ministry view.
defects.proposed_fix: Implement dedicated MinistryDetailDrawer component with subordinate board tabs.

defects.description: Sub-departments route (#sub-departments) aliases directly to primary departments without subordinate directorate breakdown.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Click 'Sub-Departments' in sidebar navigation. 2. Observe identical display as 'Departments'.
defects.expected_result: Sub-departments should list field directorates, commissionerates, and statutory boards under each Secretariat department.
defects.root_cause: Route alias in App.tsx line 161 combines ministries, departments, and sub-departments into one handler.
defects.business_impact: Lack of visibility into third-tier executive directorates (e.g. Directorate of Public Health vs Health Secretariat).
defects.proposed_fix: Create dedicated SubDepartmentDirectory listing 140+ state directorates mapped to their parent departments.

defects.description: Constituency route (#constituencies) routes to District Heatmap instead of individual Assembly Constituency scorecards.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Click 'Constituencies' in sidebar. 2. Observe District Heatmap loads instead of 234 MLA constituencies.
defects.expected_result: Should render 234 Assembly constituencies with sitting MLA name, party, and local grievance resolution index.
defects.root_cause: App.tsx line 212 groups districts, taluks, and constituencies into single DistrictHeatmapGrid renderer.
defects.business_impact: CM cannot review MLA-specific grievance redressal rate before district review meetings.
defects.proposed_fix: Build ConstituencyGrid component with MLA search, political party badges, and local infrastructure status.

defects.description: Infrastructure project progress lacks interactive Gantt timeline component; delay analysis relies on static percentage cards.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to #projects. 2. Inspect project items. 3. Observe lack of milestone time-slider.
defects.expected_result: Projects should display interactive milestone timeline with critical path delay alerts and land acquisition dependencies.
defects.actual_result: Cards display progress percentages and textual delay descriptions.
defects.root_cause: ChiefSecretaryCockpit component renders project cards with static progress bars rather than timeline chart.
defects.business_impact: Delays cannot be analyzed across seasonal monsoon windows.

defects.description: Enterprise Knowledge Hub uses client-side keyword search in standalone mode; semantic vector RAG embeddings require live Python backend.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Open #knowledge in GitHub Pages. 2. Search for conceptual queries without exact keyword match.
defects.expected_result: Semantic search matches concept across G.O. texts.
defects.actual_result: Only exact substring keyword matches return results.
defects.root_cause: Standalone client cannot host local vector index in browser without WebAssembly transformer model.
defects.business_impact: Officials must know exact terminology (e.g. 'G.O. Ms 128' rather than 'flood compensation order').
defects.proposed_fix: Compile lightweight pre-computed semantic embedding index for top 500 G.O.s in client.

defects.description: Notification ticker updates on page reload or periodic poll; Web Push Notifications are not registered with service worker.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Check browser service worker registration in DevTools. 2. Notice absence of push manager subscription.
defects.expected_result: Critical alerts (e.g. Mettur flood alert) should trigger background browser notifications.
defects.actual_result: Notifications only render when application tab is open.
defects.root_cause: No service worker registered in main.tsx for Push API.
defects.business_impact: Executive staff not actively viewing tab may miss urgent warnings.
defects.proposed_fix: Register lightweight service worker supporting Web Push API.

defects.description: Data synchronization connectors operate on simulated trigger in demo mode; real government REST APIs require VPN clearance.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Go to #data-sync. 2. Click 'Trigger Sync Now'. 3. Observe simulated sync progress.
defects.expected_result: Sync should document that live endpoints require State Data Centre (SDC) network tunnel.
defects.actual_result: Shows simulated 100% sync success without explicit connectivity banner.
defects.root_cause: Demo interceptor returns mock success payload.
defects.business_impact: Reviewers might assume live connection to TNeGA / e-District servers is established.
defects.proposed_fix: Add explicit badge: 'Simulated Sandbox Mode - Production Requires SDC VPN Tunnel'.

defects.description: User persona switching is unauthenticated in demo mode; anyone can switch between Chief Minister and District Collector without password.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Click user profile in top header. 2. Select 'Chief Minister' or 'District Collector'. 3. Role switches instantly.
defects.expected_result: Demo mode should display 'DEMO PERSONA SWITCHER - NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE' warning label.
defects.root_cause: authStore provides instant dev switcher for demonstration convenience.
defects.business_impact: Confusing for security auditors evaluating government access boundaries.
defects.proposed_fix: Add visual watermark badge indicating 'Simulation Persona Switcher Active'.

defects.description: No client-side telemetry or performance logging export to monitoring backends (Sentry / CloudWatch).
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Trigger intentional route error. 2. Observe error only logs to browser console.
defects.expected_result: Errors should be captured and surfaced in an executive error-rate dashboard.
defects.root_cause: Observability focused on backend /health endpoint; frontend error boundary telemetry not configured.
defects.business_impact: Frontend rendering issues on older mobile devices may go unnoticed.
defects.proposed_fix: Implement React ErrorBoundary with local telemetry buffer.

defects.description: Settings modal only configures language and role; no user provisioning, role permission matrix, or API token management UI.
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Click Settings in sidebar. 2. Observe only basic theme/role toggles.
defects.expected_result: Should provide full administration panel for Department IT nodal officers.
defects.root_cause: Administration module currently focused on end-user preferences.
defects.business_impact: Department IT nodal officers cannot configure role delegations.
